# Browser dependency

`supabase.js` is the unmodified UMD distribution of `@supabase/supabase-js` **2.116.0**, obtained from the npm package via jsDelivr. Its MIT licence is included as `SUPABASE-LICENSE`. The invitation loads this local pinned file, not a moving CDN version.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.116.0/dist/umd/supabase.js
